results.title: Google Drive
results.snippet:
Google Drive lets you securely store, intelligently organize and collaborate on files and folders from anywhere, on any device.

With Drive, you can:
• Safely store and access your files anywhere
• Edit and store 100+ file types, including PDFs, Office files, videos and more
• Scan and upload paper documents using your device’s camera
• Quickly access recent and important files
• Search for files by name and content
• Filter files by type, last modified date and more
• Share and set permissions for files and folders
• View your content on the go while offline
• Receive notifications about important activity on your files
• View files more easily on Android tablets with side by side view, drag and drop functionality and more

Google Workspace subscribers have access to additional Drive functionality, including:
• Using AI to summarize information, retrieve quick facts, and surface insights from your files
• Security and management controls for admins to help meet data compliance needs
• Sharing files and folders directly with groups or teams within your organization
• Creating a shared drive to store all of your team’s content
• Requesting electronic signatures and manage vendor agreements, customer contracts, and more

Learn more about Drive in Google Workspace: https://workspace.google.com/products/drive/

Learn more about Google Apps update policy: https://support.google.com/a/answer/6288871

Google accounts get 15GB of storage, shared across Google Drive, Gmail, and Google Photos. For additional storage, you can upgrade to Google One as an in-app purchase. In the US, subscriptions start at $1.99/month for 100 GB with Google One. Plans and prices can vary by region.

results.title: Cloud Backup and Data Restore
results.snippet:
All backup and restore for your daily important data backup, contacts backup, SMS messages, call logs, calendar and apps. Choose local backup or cloud backup and restore it quickly with just a few clicks.

Phone problems can happen after a factory reset, when you get a new phone, or while moving your data to another device. This free phone backup and restore app lets you save your important data and restore it anytime without using a computer.

What You Can Backup and Restore
Contacts - Save your contacts and restore them anytime.
Text Messages - Backup your SMS and MMS messages, then restore them whenever you need.
Call History - Save your call history and restore it after a factory reset or when you switch to a new phone.
Calendar - Backup your calendar events and restore them later so you don't lose important dates.
Apps - Save your app installation files (APK) and restore them later. You can also keep a copy of your APK files for future use.

Choose Where to Save Your Backup
Local Backup - Save your backup on your phone for quick and easy access.
Cloud Backup - Upload your backup to cloud storage to keep it safe and restore it whenever you need.
You can change where your backups are saved anytime in Settings.

Before you restore
Restore works only for backups created with this app; it can't recover previously deleted data.
This is data backup and restore, not live data transfer between phones.
Photos and videos aren't included - this tool focuses on contacts backup, SMS backup, call logs, calendar, and app backup and restore.

Secure and Private
Your data never goes to our servers. All backups stored on your device or personal Google Drive. We never collect, sell, or share your data. Complete privacy and security guaranteed.

Key Features:
SMS backup and restore
Contacts backup and restore
Call log backup and restore
Calendar backup and restore
APK and app backup and restore
Document and file backup
Google Drive cloud backup
Local storage backup
Phone clone and data transfer
One tap full phone backup
Data recovery and restore
Secure and private backup
New phone data transfer

Download Cloud Backup and Data Recovery - the best phone backup app, data transfer app, phone clone app, and data recovery app for Android. Never lose your data again!

⚠️ Disclaimer:
SMS restore requires the app to temporarily become the default SMS handler as mandated by Android OS. This role is only requested during SMS restore and not used for any other purpose. Your data is never transmitted to our servers.

results.title: Drive Backup
results.snippet:
Drive Backup copies files from Android folders you choose to an app-specific folder in your Google Drive.

Choose one or more folders, exclude subfolders you do not need, and run a backup manually or on a schedule. Existing Drive files are compared before upload so unchanged files can be skipped. Large files use resumable uploads, and progress is visible in the app and Android notification.

Your files and account data are not sent to a developer-operated server. Google authorization is handled by Google Identity Services, and Drive access is limited to files created or explicitly opened by Drive Backup.

Features:

• Manual and scheduled folder backup
• Wi-Fi-only option
• Excluded subfolders
• Resumable large-file uploads
• Duplicate and changed-file detection
• Progress, cancellation, and on-device diagnostics

Requires Android 7.0 or newer and a Google account.

results.title: MobiDrive Cloud Storage & Sync
results.snippet:
MobiDrive is a streamlined, secure and ad-free cloud storage with handy features to backup, sync and access all your files. From its free 20GB storage available on sign in, to its rich cross-platform capabilities, MobiDrive ensures secure content transfer regardless of file format, device, platform, or location.

SECURE DRIVE WITH AMPLE STORAGE
• Want 20GB free cloud storage, zero ads and no strings attached? Just create an account, claim your free storage, and sync or backup any file.
• Need a practical video storage or photo storage but the free 20 GB aren’t enough? Upgrade your drive to up to 2TB and enjoy sufficient storage to sync and backup.

INSTANT ACCESS TO YOUR FILES
• MobiDrive’s content transfer is straightforward and fast. Secure and sync files and folders to your drive in seconds.
• Ensure your photo storage and video storage are always up-to-date with the auto backup of photos and videos to the drive.
• With MobiDrive’s seamless cross-platform capabilities you can sync your drive and create a backup on any mobile device, Windows PC or browser.

POWERFUL FILE MANAGEMENT TO KEEP YOUR DRIVE TIDY
• MobiDrive supports all major photo, video and office file formats, making it an ideal solution for photo storage, video storage, or a secure space for your work files.

ENSURE YOUR FILES ARE ALWAYS SECURE
• Accidentally delete a file? Restore it from the Bin section, housing files you’ve deleted from your drive.
• Access previous versions of any file stored on your cloud drive and relax knowing you always have a secure backup.
• Any file you sync or backup in a content transfer to your drive is protected for 30 days, meaning that even if it was deleted or changed, you can always bring it back.

EFFORTLESS SHARING & CONTENT TRANSFER
• Need to urgently share a file but your device isn’t nearby? Just sync your drive files on any mobile device, Windows PC, or browser to make fast and secure content transfers on-the-go.
• Content transfer has never been easier, just create a download link. Share precious memories from your photo storage or video storage with friends and family in seconds.
• Enjoy dedicated ‘Shared with me’ and ‘Shared by me’ sections to keep an eye on any content transfer involving files on your drive.
• Mark a drive file as available ‘Offline’ for use without the need to sync or have internet.
• You can also share files from your drive as an attachment.

DO MORE WITH PREMIUM
Supersize your drive and unlock powerful new features for your files.
• Up to 2TB Cloud Storage - Ensure you have cloud storage for even the largest content transfer by upgrading your drive to up to 2TB.
• 180 Days of File Protection - Restore deleted files from the Bin and access version histories for an extended period of up to 180 days.
• Convert Files in 1200+ Formats - Enjoy a handy backup if a file on your drive is incompatible. Convert to all major photo, video, and office file formats.
• Premium MobiOffice Pack - Upgrade to a 2TB MobiDrive license and get a game-changer for your office files. MobiOffice shares advanced cross-platform integration with MobiDrive, allowing you to seamlessly sync and backup your office files anywhere.

results.title: Autosync for Google Drive
results.snippet:
This app is an automatic file sync and backup tool. It lets you automatically synchronize files and folders with Google Drive cloud storage and with your other devices. It is an ideal tool for photo sync, document and file backup, automatic file transfer, automatic file sharing between devices,...

New files in your cloud account are automatically downloaded onto your device. New files in your device are uploaded. If you delete a file on one side, it will be deleted on the other side. It works across multiple devices (your phone and your tablet). If their folders are synced with the same cloud account, they will be kept in sync with each other.

This is how Google Drive works on computers but not on Android. Two-way automatic synchronization should be an essential function of the official app. For whatever reason, it is not the case. Autosync for Google Drive is here to fill the gap.

All file transfers and communications between user devices and cloud storage servers are securely encrypted and do not go through our servers. No outsiders will be able to decrypt, see or modify any file contents.

MAIN FEATURES

• Full two-way automatic synchronization of files and folders
• Very efficient, consumes almost no battery
• Easy to set up. Once set up files will be kept in sync without any effort from users
• Works reliably under ever changing network conditions on your phone
• Monitors battery level, WiFi/3G/4G/LTE connectivity and adapts its behavior according to user preferences
• Configurable autosync interval: 15 minutes, 30 minutes, every hour,...

If you like this app, please consider upgrading to premium version. By doing so you support the development efforts and get access to premium features. You can upgrade via in-app purchase.

PREMIUM FEATURES

• Sync multiple pairs of folders
• Upload files larger than 10 MB
• Sync your entire cloud account with a folder in your device
• Sync with multiple accounts
• Sync with shared drives
• Protect app settings with passcode
• No ads displayed in the app
• Email support by developer

SUPPORT

Please check out our website (http://metactrl.com/) for more information about the app, including User's Guide (http://metactrl.com/userguide/) and FAQ (http://metactrl.com/faq/). If you run into any issues or have suggestions for improvements, don't hesitate to email us at drivesync@metactrl.com. We will do our best to assist you.

results.title: Swift Backup
results.snippet:
Keep the parts of your Android setup that matter.

Restore them when you switch phones, reset your device or need an earlier backup. Swift Backup gives you one place to manage local, cloud and self-hosted backups without locking you into a single storage provider.

What you can back up
• Apps and APKs
• App data and selected app settings on rooted devices
• Messages and call logs
• Folders and files
• Applied wallpapers
• Saved Wi-Fi networks with Root or Shizuku on supported Android versions

Store backups your way
Save backups on internal storage, an SD card or USB drive where supported.

Connect Swift Backup to:
• Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and Box
• Mega.nz, pCloud, Filen, Yandex.Disk and Cloud Mail.Ru
• WebDAV, including Nextcloud, ownCloud and compatible NAS devices
• S3-compatible storage
• SMB, SFTP, FTP, FTPS and FTPES servers

Designed for real backup workflows
• Create device and cloud backups
• Restore individual APKs manually without root
• Use Root or Shizuku for supported batch operations
• Keep multiple app backup versions, add notes and protect important backups
• Schedule recurring backups to device storage or a connected cloud account
• Group apps with labels and apply custom backup and restore configurations
• Use incremental folder backups to store changed files efficiently
• Search apps, share APKs and manage backups from one clear home screen

Root and Shizuku
Root is not required to back up APKs, messages, call logs, folders or wallpapers.

Backing up and restoring private app data requires root. Some protected app files and batch restore actions require Root or Shizuku, depending on your Android version. See the FAQ for exact requirements.

Premium features
• Cloud backups for apps and folders
• Scheduled backups
• Backup history, notes and protected backups
• App labels
• Custom app backup and restore configurations

Sign-in and encryption
You can use Swift Backup anonymously and offline for local backups. Google Sign-in is required for cloud backups and Premium features. Browser-based sign-in is available on devices without Google Play services.

Backups are encrypted, except APKs, expansion files and wallpapers. Backups are tied to the Swift Backup account used to create them, so use the same account when moving to another device.

Learn more
• FAQ: www.swiftapps.org/faq
• Common issues: www.swiftapps.org/issues
• Email: support@swiftapps.org
• Telegram: https://t.me/swiftbackupsupport

results.title: Autosync - File Sync & Backup
results.snippet:
Please note: This is a trial version. When the trial period expires, you will be requested to purchase to continue using the app.

Autosync is an automatic file sync and backup tool. You choose which folder in your device should be synced with which folder in your cloud storage account, and how. Autosync will then keep files in these two folders in sync with each other, automatically and without any additional efforts from the user.

The official cloud storage apps don't have automatic sync capabilities, or only to a very limited extent. The commonly offered automatic photo upload might suffice for simple photo backup but not for keeping photos on multiple devices synchronized. If you want automatic file sync between your device and your cloud storage, you need this app.

Autosync can be configured to do automatic file sharing between your devices, to back up selected folders in your phone to your cloud storage, or to make backup copies of important document folders in your cloud storage and save them in your device for offline use. These are a few examples of what you can accomplish with automatic file sync.

All file transfers and communication between user devices and cloud storage servers are securely encrypted and do not go through our servers. Outsiders, including us, will not be able to decrypt and hence see or modify any file contents.

Supported storage services and protocols:

• Google Drive
• OneDrive
• SharePoint Online
• Dropbox
• Box
• MEGA
• Nextcloud
• ownCloud
• pCloud
• Yandex Disk
• WebDAV
• FTP
• SFTP (ssh/scp)
• LAN/SMB network drives

If your cloud storage is not on the list, please check if it supports WebDAV protocol. WebDAV is widely supported by many storage service vendors.

LAN/SMB network drives are supported by Windows/Mac/Linux computers and NAS devices. This app can sync with them via local network.

Support

• Website: https://metactrl.com/autosync/
• Email: autosync@metactrl.com (please use English)

-----
This "Autosync Universal" app supports multiple cloud storage services in a single app. Users who use only one cloud storage may prefer one of our single-cloud "Autosync for ..." apps. They are smaller, have fewer features but are simpler and easier to use than this all-in-one app.

results.title: IDrive Online Backup
results.snippet:

Securely backup your mobile data with private key encryption - the highest level of data security available - so only you can access your files. You can backup multiple devices to one account, and sync files across devices to access your data from anywhere.

Features:
*Backup and restore contacts, photos, videos, calendars, texts and documents (including .doc, .pdf, .zip and more) with a single tap.
*Easily sync files between all linked devices.
*Link your devices to a single account and access your data from anywhere.
*Selectively backup and restore files.
*Share files and folders over a single, secure link.
*Automatic upload option protects your photos and videos as soon as they are taken via Wi-Fi or cellular data.
*Schedule recurring backups by day and time.
*Gallery View allows you to easily slide through all your pictures and videos.

Security features:
*256-bit AES encryption
*Private key encryption ensures only you have access to your data
*Lock app with a passcode.
*Easily unlink devices which are lost or stolen

Information on permissions:
*"Read and Edit your text messages" is required to backup and restore text messages.
*"Network access, network and Wi-Fi connections" is required to reach Wi-Fi and cellular network for backing up your data.
*"Read, add or modify Calendar Events" is required to backup and restore calendar.
*"To read/write Call Logs and Contacts" is required to backup, access, and restore your call history and contacts.
*"Read Phone" is required to get the device ID which helps distinguish your device.
*"Accounts" is required for accessing Play Store for making in-app purchases.
*"Run at startup" is required to run scheduled backups.
